name: Node-RED
tagline: Wire devices, APIs and services together in a visual flow editor.
description: Node-RED builds automations by connecting nodes in the browser: MQTT, HTTP, home automation, databases and thousands of community nodes.
postInstall: The editor has no password at first and can run commands: protect it (adminAuth in settings.js, see Securing Node-RED in its docs) before opening it beyond your network.
Flows and installed nodes are kept in its Data volume.
